title: More on Bill Robinson and Lee's poor memory for years
summary: He says he cannot date events, only incidents, and recalls Robinson running backwards faster than others ran forward.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Okay, we'll deal with it when we get there. One other thing; you said that you once saw Bill Robinson when he was traveling with the medicine show?
Yeah, the medicine show, that's right.
Do you remember what year and where? Do you remember how old you were?
No, see, that's the difficult thing about me. Now I can tell you about situations and incidents, you know, but I don't have a clue to the year then, and if you

bring it on up in to the years, most anything I'm telling you about, I will not be able to tell you the year, you know? I have never been in to that, and I've never been able to do that -- but I can tell you the situations and what happened.

Now somebody else will have to tell me what year it happened, unless you're gonna come up to the years where -- I think from Nat Cole on I would remember, you know, but beyond that, I couldn't tell you the year. Like I can tell you the year -- okay, we come from Phoenix and we come to Los Angeles, now do you want to do that? Okay.
Do you remember where it was? The medicine show?

No ... it was in the south someplace, though. Someplace in the south, because -- here's another thing that Bill Robinson did, and I'm sure that people that is in to him will know this. He used to do something which I saw him do as a kid, he would run backwards faster than most people could run forward. And he used to bet on it, and he used to win, you know? The guy was fantastic. You look that up sometimes, and see how Bill Robinson could run backwards faster than most people could run forward, and he won a lot of money betting on that. And he did, too. He could.
